# :checkhealth errors that are expected in CI and do not mean the config is broken.
#
# Each line is an extended regular expression (grep -E) matched against
#   <healthcheck> / <section>: <first line of the message>
# e.g.
#   vim.health / Terminal: Graphics protocol: not supported by this terminal.
# Every other ERROR in the report fails the ":checkhealth" step, so keep the
# patterns specific. (check.sh sets a UTF-8 locale and $TERM, so the locale
# and terminfo errors of vim.health do not show up in the first place.)

# Headless Nvim has no terminal that could answer the graphics protocol query.
^vim\.health / Terminal: Graphics protocol: not supported by this terminal\.$

# lazy.nvim needs luarocks (or hererocks) only for plugins that ship a rockspec.
^lazy / luarocks:
